Parse a vsearch LCA + userout pair into a REGATTA taxonomy table

Source: R/parse_vsearch_results.R
parse_vsearch_results.Rd

Joins the conservative LCA call from vsearch's --lcaout file with the percent identity from vsearch's --userout file (first hit per ASV) and returns a clean per-ASV table: ASV_id + 7 lowercase rank columns + pct_id. Drop-in as global_table or local_table for reconcile_global_local() or as the input to reconcile_checklist().

parse_vsearch_results(lca_path, userout_path, id_col = "ASV_id")

Arguments

lca_path

Path to the vsearch LCA file (2 cols: ID, sintax).

userout_path

Path to the vsearch userout file (6 cols: ID, sequence;tax, pct_id, alnlen, mism, opens).

id_col

Column name to use for the ASV identifier in the output (default "ASV_id").

Value

A data.frame with id_col + 7 rank columns + pct_id. ASVs in the LCA file with no userout hit get pct_id = NA.

Details

Use this in preference to parse_vsearch_userout() when you have both files. The userout's column 2 carries the best hit's taxonomy (potentially species-level even when the top-N hits disagree); the LCA file carries the consensus across the top-N (often more conservative). Calling reconciliation on the LCA taxonomy matches the original code semantics and is methodologically more honest.
